title: Arabic — Audio-First MSA to C2
source_policy: Use a source-diverse mix of public/open YouTube, university audio, Al Jazeera Learning Arabic, graded media, podcasts, and authentic MSA.

stages.goal: Core pronunciation, greetings, identity, family, daily needs, basic nominal/verbal patterns, high-frequency vocabulary and short exchanges.
primary: Al Jazeera Learning Arabic beginner video dialogues
University of Wisconsin MSA listening lessons
stages.exit: Demonstrate A1 reception, production, interaction, and mediation; do not advance based only on lesson count.

stages.goal: Routine transactions, connected descriptions of daily life and past/routine events, core tense/aspect patterns, larger high-frequency lexicon.
primary: Al Jazeera Learning Arabic elementary/A2 material
reinforcement: alternate dialogues on shopping, travel, health, routines and family
stages.exit: Handle routine exchanges and understand clear learner-targeted MSA without English scaffolding most of the time.

stages.goal: Independent comprehension of clear standard speech, narrative ability, reasons/opinions, transition toward native-speed graded media.
primary: Al Jazeera Learning Arabic B1/intermediate general and media language
reinforcement: second explanations of core morphology and syntax
stages.exit: Follow main points of clear standard media and sustain connected speech on familiar topics.

stages.goal: Extended standard discourse, abstract topics, natural-speed media, flexible grammar and broad productive vocabulary.
reinforcement: same issues covered by multiple speakers/sources
stages.exit: Understand extended standard discourse and interact with reasonable fluency on concrete and abstract subjects.

stages.goal: Implicit meaning, academic/professional register, dense native media, stylistic control and sustained spontaneous expression.
primary: native lectures, interviews, documentaries, long-form MSA audio
reinforcement: multi-source treatment of the same issue
older grammar reappearing inside authentic discourse
stages.exit: Use Arabic flexibly and understand demanding extended discourse with limited support.

stages.goal: Near-complete comprehension across speed/register, precise nuance, synthesis across sources, specialized vocabulary and effortless reformulation.
primary: native specialist lectures, debates, literature/audio books, formal interviews and documentaries
reinforcement: dialect-aware listening without replacing MSA production
stages.exit: Meet C2 descriptors across listening, reading, speaking, writing, interaction and mediation; playlist completion alone is insufficient.

parallel_branches.quranic_classical: light exposure early; systematic parallel branch from A2/B1
parallel_branches.dialect: add a clearly labeled conversational dialect branch after stable A2/B1 MSA
parallel_branches.pronunciation: continuous corrective shadowing and targeted sound work throughout
